implementationScope: compile-checked TaskScope/Task/TaskLocal/ActorLocal/ThreadLocal/trace continuation contract; source-free model is advisory only
invariants: A cancellation request does not mean quiescence and never unlocks an executing thread-affine mutex
Compiler-owned logical leases close exactly once, in LIFO unwind order, after physical quiescence; a failed release poisons the reclamation witness
Await and carrier migration preserve TaskLocal and immutable causal trace lineage, not physical ThreadLocal
TaskLocal children default to noninheritance; explicitly copied immutable Send values are independent
ActorLocal remains actor-incarnation and critical-gated; no authority crosses ActorRef.send or tenants implicitly
Tracing is bounded, source-mapped, redacted, and branch-causal; foreign callbacks carry provenance only, not task/actor authority
Structured scope exit waits for physically retired children and cleanup; no orphan or silent detached task
All five backends must prove native guest execution of identical positive/negative .atto fixtures

scenarios.mustHold: Stages run in source order with typed one-layer Future results, not implicit flattening
A failed stage suppresses downstream stages and preserves original failure
Parent cancellation seals admission and propagates only to owned descendants
Child cancellation does not cancel parent or unrelated sibling
Exactly one terminal outcome wins but cleanup still waits for physical quiescence
A cancellation request cannot unlock a still-running thread-affine lock
Verified transferable logical lock leases release once and in reverse registration order
Cancelled waiter and granted permit cannot both claim the same lock; no permit leak
Failed lease release is visible and cannot yield successful get_done reclamation
Deferred asynchronous cleanup is bounded and awaited before physical retirement
TaskLocal follows logical task across await and carrier migration
Child TaskLocal defaults empty without a snapshot
Explicit immutable Send snapshot cannot mutate parent or inherit authority
ActorLocal requires actor incarnation, turn and critical-write authority
ThreadLocal remains physical-thread scoped; guest Tasks cannot use it as authorization
Producer-thread callback cannot restore revoked Task/Actor generation
Await/resume retain trace identity and trusted causal parent without fake stack frames
Siblings preserve branch ancestry; a join never invents a total order
Cancellation and cleanup retain original trace lineage and bounded secondary errors
Actor send serializes only approved bounded trace metadata, never live local handles

evidence.admissible: Only independently checked exact-head, nonzero-step compiler-backed guest execution, native/AOT where applicable.
evidence.release: Independent review and actual quiescence/lock-race/trace tests are mandatory before merge or parity promotion.
